state.request: A request cites exactly one accepted available anchor artifact when it is fulfilled. Other artifacts and each support relation are independently governed records; lists are a read projection. A submitted group is not implicitly all-or-none.
state.race: An artifact was read as available at time A. At time B its disposal commits. At time C an external delivery sends the artifact bytes, and afterward an asynchronous reactor writes a disclosure log record.
state.capture: The artifact becomes available only after a clean inspection; detected secrets are rejected and content purged. A redacted derivative is a separate artifact and requires independent approval before disclosure.
state.delivery: The source delivery has a stable operation ID, the artifact has an immutable content hash, each disclosure names the artifact, exact release operation and recipient. A delivery can time out after sending bytes and be retried.

single_anchor.instructions: Does one available anchor plus independent additional links avoid collecting every submitted artifact on the request?

atomic_batch.instructions: Does recording one anchor by itself prove that every artifact in a concurrently submitted group was accepted atomically?

stale_availability.instructions: In the race, can the delivery release bytes after the artifact was disposed despite the earlier available read?

late_audit_guard.instructions: Can writing the disclosure log after the delivery prevent the already completed bytes from being disclosed?

duplicate_log.instructions: Can retrying a delivery after an ambiguous timeout create duplicate disclosure logs if log identity is randomly generated each attempt?

unknown_is_no.instructions: After a delivery timeout with unknown acceptance, is it guaranteed that no recipient got bytes?

redaction_approval.instructions: Does a derivative being inspected clean by itself prove its redaction was approved for external disclosure?

parent_growth.instructions: Would an artifact aggregate that appends one event for every independent support link have history growing with the number of links?

conditional_auth.instructions: If a true authoritative per-artifact delivery fence makes eligibility and release atomic against quarantine and disposal, would that exclude the stated stale-read race for those changes?
